notes: Bare *even* is the word the ASV spent on the extent עַד with no conjunction before it (rules 16, 40); the apodosis waw before לֹא gets no connective and is `unrepresented` (rule 14).
לֹא takes the *no* the negation has become on the supplied complement (rule 15), while יַאֲהִיל → *hath … brightness* heads on the complement under rule 44.
